topic: Hall-defect generic rank for fortified proximal completeness on structural-zero supports. Allow coordinate-specific finite proxy alphabets and a declared structural support S. Construct the fortified support-incidence space, quotient block-null space Nbar, and Hall defect eta; prove generic rank Q-kappa0-eta on the compatible positive factor-table model, the necessary-and-sufficient full-rank Hall inequalities, generic attainment or law-uniform route failure, and an exact rank-oracle/submodular algorithm. Treat the banked rectangular theorem only as a special case and preserve the distinction among generic feasibility, actual-law completeness, and ATE identification. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: exact nine-cell computation gives supply=demand 12 but rank 11 and Hall defect one; all 135 K=2 binary cases match, and positive stochastic perturbations realize required block spaces. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: product-block Rado attainment and rational-function specialization. EARLY KILL TEST: prove the abstract block-Rado formula; any counterexample pivots or stops.

open_problems.open_problem: For coordinate-specific finite proxy alphabets and declared structural-zero support S, is the generic rank of the fortified completeness pairing exactly Q-kappa0-eta(S), with eta the quotient block-Hall defect, or does shared product-factor parameterization admit a counterexample to abstract Rado attainment?

source_refs.excerpt: Extend the weighted-dimension and compatible-minor arguments to coordinate-specific proxy cardinalities
with structural zeros, deriving a support-pattern-specific necessary-and-sufficient generic-rank condition

source_refs.claim: Finite-proxy proximal identification is reduced to matrix-rank conditions, without a structural-zero support characterization.
source_refs.author: Wang Miao, Zhi Geng, Eric J. Tchetgen Tchetgen

source_refs.claim: Rado characterizes independent transversals through rank inequalities over every subfamily.
source_refs.author: Richard Rado

source_refs.claim: A minimax rank theorem is established for a restricted class of generic partitioned matrices with independently generic parameters.
source_refs.author: Satoru Iwata, Kazuo Murota
source_refs.venue: SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications

open_problems.why_unsolved: The banked rectangular theorem relies on a common alphabet, full-cell support, and a decomposition in which compatible positive tables realize the needed block spaces. Structural zeros and heterogeneous alphabets create locally deficient block families even when aggregate supply equals demand. Classical Rado theory permits independent selection from prescribed subspaces, whereas every fortified block here must arise simultaneously from shared stochastic factors. Thus the abstract Hall upper bound need not be attainable on the Segre-like compatible model. The unresolved first step is a product-block Rado theorem followed by a nonvanishing rational specialization, or a minimal support counterexample.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A theorem proving generic rank Q-kappa0-max_I{|I|-dim(sum_{i in I} V_i/Nbar)} and eta=0 equivalence to all quotient Hall inequalities, together with a compatible positive rational factor table attaining that rank, or an explicit support and alphabet profile refuting attainment.

writing_exemplar.why: Its fortified-completeness formulation supplies the destination problem and the distinction between defended proxy subsets and an injective pairing.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: candidate proxies may contain invalid coordinates -> fortified moments protect specified valid subsets -> identification still needs an injective finite pairing -> structural zeros require an exact Hall frontier for generic feasibility

method_exemplars.technique: Use the independent-transversal theorem to derive the quotient all-subfamilies rank inequalities and maximum-defect upper bound.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The proposed eta is precisely the deficiency of selecting independent representatives from quotient block spaces; the new work is lifting those representatives through the shared product parameterization.

method_exemplars.technique: Exhibit one nonzero maximal minor at a compatible parameter specialization and invoke algebraic genericity on the product-model image.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both problems require proving that a determinant polynomial is not identically zero on a constrained finite latent product model.

method_exemplars.technique: After completeness is certified, carry the unique bridge into a proximal influence-function estimator and its asymptotic-linearity proof.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the direct estimation and limit-theory rung for actual compatible laws away from the exceptional rank locus.

open_problems.open_problem: Can the fortified Hall defect and generic rank be computed exactly from structural-support incidence and quotient-block rank oracles, with a deficient-subset certificate and an attaining compatible specialization?

source_refs.excerpt: The function rho is a normalized, monotone, submodular rank function.
give a single encoded union model, explicit input size and a termination, complexity, or useful certificate-degree guara

source_refs.claim: A constructive polynomial-time algorithm computes symbolic rank and maximum-rank completions for generic partitioned matrices with 2-by-2 coefficient blocks.
source_refs.author: Hiroshi Hirai, Yuni Iwamasa

source_refs.claim: Term rank and systems of distinct representatives admit exact algebraic and computational formulations.
source_refs.author: Jack Edmonds
source_refs.venue: Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards, Section B

open_problems.why_unsolved: The banked proof invokes submodularity only as an existential ingredient in a full-support attainment argument. On arbitrary supports, eta is defined by exponentially many subsets, while matching algorithms assume independently parameterized entries and existing partitioned-matrix algorithms cover much narrower block forms. The missing step is to prove that quotient supply dimension is exactly evaluable and submodular under the fortified incidence representation, then control oracle and rational bit complexity and connect the optimizing subset back to compatible product-block attainment.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A bit-complexity-bounded polynomial algorithm outputting eta, Q-kappa0-eta, and a maximizing Hall-deficient subset, and, conditional on product-block attainment, a rational positive compatible factor table whose fortified matrix has the certified rank.

writing_exemplar.why: Its sensitivity sweep makes an executable feasibility diagnostic valuable when analysts change the defended proxy configuration.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: fortified analysis varies defended proxy subsets -> feasibility depends on many interacting rank constraints -> exhaustive subset checks are impractical -> an exact oracle should identify either full feasibility or the obstructing support block

method_exemplars.technique: Apply strongly polynomial submodular-function minimization to demand minus quotient projection rank, using an exact rank-value oracle.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Once eta is rewritten as submodular minimization, this machinery directly returns an optimizing deficient subset with a complexity guarantee.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt the augmenting symbolic-rank algorithm and its constructive maximum-rank completion certificate.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both settings generalize bipartite matching to block-structured symbolic rank; the fortified oracle adds quotient spaces and product-coupled stochastic blocks.

method_exemplars.technique: Use generalized Wong sequences to construct maximum-rank elements when the support oracle is represented as a linear matrix space.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It provides an algebraic fallback if the quotient-incidence object cannot be exposed directly as a standard matroid oracle.

open_problems.open_problem: Which declared structural supports make fortified proximal completeness uniform over every compatible positive factor table, rather than only generic outside a proper determinantal exceptional set?

source_refs.claim: Finite latent product models can be generically identifiable although global identification fails on an exceptional parameter set.
source_refs.author: Elizabeth S. Allman, Catherine Matias, John A. Rhodes

source_refs.claim: Compatibility of discrete conditional distributions with structural zeros requires support-sensitive constraints and an explicit compatibility procedure.
source_refs.author: Yuchung J. Wang, Kun-Lin Kuo

source_refs.claim: Algebraic dependencies and determinant cancellation can separate constrained rank from free generic-parameter rank.
source_refs.author: András Recski, Áron Vékássy
source_refs.venue: Periodica Polytechnica Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

open_problems.why_unsolved: A nonzero symbolic minor establishes generic attainment but supplies no lower bound at a particular compatible law. Positivity does not remove the determinant-zero locus, and compatibility restrictions may either force cancellations or permit exceptional positive laws within an otherwise generically complete support. Proximal theory assumes completeness at the actual law, while generic latent-model theory tolerates exceptional laws; neither supplies a support-only classification separating these claims.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient support characterization partitioning S into uniformly full-rank, generically-but-not-uniformly full-rank, and generically deficient classes, with explicit exceptional positive families for the middle class and a route-failure certificate for the last.

writing_exemplar.why: Its careful separation of global and generic identifiability supplies the framing needed to prevent generic feasibility from being reported as actual-law completeness.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: latent product models may fail global identification -> algebraic minors recover generic identification -> exceptional compatible laws remain possible -> fortified supports need an exact uniform-versus-generic frontier

method_exemplars.technique: Use polynomial parameterization, nonvanishing-minor witnesses, and exceptional-variety arguments to establish the generic side of the classification.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The compatible proxy model is likewise a polynomial image whose incomplete locus is determinantal.

method_exemplars.technique: Impose support-sensitive compatibility constraints and construct compatible joint distributions realizing proposed exceptional tables.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Uniform claims must quantify over tables corresponding to actual positive joint laws on S, not arbitrary collections of conditional matrices.

method_exemplars.technique: Debias a strongly identified linear causal functional using penalized minimax nuisance estimators even when its bridge nuisance is weakly identified.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It provides the appropriate inference benchmark for actual laws approaching or lying on an exceptional bridge-rank locus.

open_problems.open_problem: When eta(S)>0 or an actual compatible factor table is rank deficient, what is the sharp proximal ATE identified set after restricting algebraic bridge-null directions to those realizable by positive latent SCMs on S?

source_refs.author: Jeffrey Zhang, Wei Li, Wang Miao, Eric J. Tchetgen Tchetgen

source_refs.author: AmirEmad Ghassami, Ilya Shpitser, Eric J. Tchetgen Tchetgen

open_problems.why_unsolved: Hall defect measures an algebraic rank shortfall, not causal variation. The ATE loading may annihilate every bridge-null direction, and even a target-active algebraic direction may not arise from any nonnegative latent SCM satisfying the declared structural support and proxy restrictions. A prior finite realizability attempt failed because its second observed law did not force the asserted latent face. The first new step is therefore to intersect the quotient block-null space with the feasible tangent cone or fiber of compatible positive factor tables and then prove endpoint attainability.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A finite optimization characterization of the sharp ATE interval over compatible latent factor tables, with a criterion for point identification despite eta>0 and strictly positive paired SCM witnesses whenever the lower and upper endpoints differ.

writing_exemplar.why: It supplies the essential distinction between bridge nonuniqueness and causal-functional nonidentification that a Hall-defect result must preserve.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: completeness can fail and bridge solutions can be nonunique -> the ATE may nevertheless annihilate all algebraic null directions -> structural support further restricts causal realizability -> characterize the sharp ATE set instead of declaring route failure equivalent to nonidentification

method_exemplars.technique: Apply the null-annihilator characterization to remove target-inactive quotient directions before imposing latent realizability.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It gives the exact algebraic condition distinguishing a nonunique bridge from a nonunique causal mean.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt finite response-function polynomial optimization and its constructive sharpness proof to the fortified support and quotient-null equations.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired endpoints are images of a finite latent SCM fiber rather than extrema over an unrestricted bridge affine space.

method_exemplars.technique: Invert sample moment criteria over the identified set and derive coverage for its endpoint or support-function estimates.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Once latent-realizable sharp endpoints are characterized, their inference becomes a finite-dimensional set-inference problem.

open_problems.open_problem: What is the coordinate-specific structural-support Hall frontier for the fortified treatment-bridge route, and when does that route remain generically feasible after the fortified outcome-completeness route fails?

source_refs.excerpt: Develop the parallel finite-support barrier for the anchor's fortified treatment-bridge route
explicitly delimiting which identification route remains viable below the frontier

open_problems.why_unsolved: The banked theorem treats only the fortified outcome-bridge pairing. The treatment route reverses conditional roles but does not simply transpose the support-incidence construction: its admissible proxy coordinates, quotient null space, and shared factor dependencies differ. The first changed proof step is deriving its own block decomposition and determining whether the outcome and treatment defects are ordered, incomparable, or equal only under an explicit support symmetry.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A treatment-route generic-rank and Hall-defect theorem on structural supports, followed by a necessary-and-sufficient classification of supports into outcome-only, treatment-only, both-route, and neither-route feasible regions.

writing_exemplar.why: It presents fortified outcome- and treatment-bridge routes as alternative mechanisms and therefore supplies the route-comparison framing.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: fortified proximal inference offers multiple bridge routes -> the banked rank theorem certifies only the outcome route -> structural zeros affect the two proxy directions asymmetrically -> classify which identification route survives for each support

method_exemplars.technique: Start from the treatment-side conditional moment equations and derive their fortified supply, demand, and quotient spaces directly.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It defines the exact treatment pairing whose structural-support feasibility must be characterized.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt finite categorical proxy-rank arguments separately to each channel orientation rather than assuming symmetric recoverability.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its categorical matrix formulation exposes why treatment- and outcome-proxy channels need not have the same injectivity frontier.

method_exemplars.technique: Use the treatment-bridge influence-function construction and its asymptotic-linearity argument on supports certified by the new route-specific Hall criterion.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the estimation rung once treatment-route completeness is established at the actual law.

literature_map:
Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2018, Biometrika) reduce finite-proxy identification to matrix-rank conditions but do not characterize rank from structural-zero supports.
Cui et al. (2024, JASA; arXiv:2011.08411) formulate proximal completeness as operator injectivity and give the usual global categorical proxy-versus-latent cardinality condition.
Zhang et al. (2023, Statistics & Probability Letters; arXiv:2303.10134) show that bridge uniqueness is unnecessary when the ATE functional annihilates the bridge null space.
Bennett et al. (2023, COLT; arXiv:2208.08291) develop debiased inference for strongly identified functionals of weakly identified or nonunique inverse-problem nuisances.
Ghassami, Shpitser, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (arXiv:2304.04374) obtain causal bounds without completeness, leaving a route from Hall defect to sharp support-specific bounds.
Lee and Bareinboim (2021, NeurIPS) and Shpitser, Wood-Doughty, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2023, JMLR; arXiv:2108.06818) integrate proxy matrix equations into causal identification algorithms.
Rado (1942, QJM) supplies the all-subfamilies rank criterion for independent representatives, the abstract source of the proposed Hall defect.
Edmonds (1967, Journal of Research NBS) links systems of distinct representatives, term rank, generic matrices, and exact computation.
Edmonds (1970) supplies the submodular and polymatroid machinery needed to optimize deficiency without enumerating every subset.
Iwata and Murota (1995, SIAM JMAA) prove a minimax theorem for a restricted generic partitioned-matrix class, but not for stochastic product-block parameterizations.
Hirai and Iwamasa (2022, Mathematical Programming; arXiv:2004.10443) give a constructive exact-rank algorithm for generic partitioned matrices with 2-by-2 blocks.
Allman, Matias, and Rhodes (2009, Annals of Statistics; arXiv:0809.5032) prove generic identifiability of finite latent product models through algebraic specialization while distinguishing generic from global claims.
Recski and Vékássy (2021) document how parameter dependencies and determinant cancellation can separate constrained rank from free generic rank.
Wang and Kuo (2010, Journal of Multivariate Analysis) show that structural zeros require explicit compatibility constraints before conditional tables represent a joint law.
Targeted searches combining proximal completeness with Hall conditions, structural zeros, generic rank, and confounding bridges found no paper occupying the product-block Rado and support-incidence theorem requested here.
prior_proposal_map:
The current scm_fortified_proxy_alphabets/v2 directory contained orchestration metadata but no proposal core or review artifact to mine.
The highest-priority source was downgraded scm_fortified_proxy_threshold/v1; its README, proto core, final writeup, compatible-minor solve artifact, and angle0_v1-v8 reviews were inspected.
That banked run proves the equal-cardinality, full-cell rectangular theorem and explicitly prescribes the coordinate-specific structural-zero support-pattern lift as its field-tier strengthening.
Its writeup supplied the reusable weighted-array, quotient projection-rank, submodularity, positive stochastic-subspace realization, and rational-minor constructions.
Angle0_v5 and angle0_v8 reviewer JSONs independently yielded the unresolved parallel treatment-bridge frontier.
Failed eid_proximal_completeness/v1, eid_proximal_bridge_quotient/v1, and eid_proximal_quotient_inference_phase/v1 were inspected to preserve the distinction between completeness, target invariance, and inference.
Failed pid_proximal_null_realizability/v1 and its rejected angles and reviews exposed the unresolved gap between algebraic block-null directions and latent-SCM-realizable ATE variation, while documenting an invalid earlier finite witness.
Downgraded scm_proxy_targetspan_transport/v1 was inspected as an adjacent rank-deficient proxy result but was not treated as the rectangular fortified-completeness parent.
